Two quesions . Can Graverobbing (superior) be used on ones own
torporized vamps to give unblockable(except by Anneke or Eagles Sight)
escape from torpor) . The card text does specify it can be used on vamps
from 'Any' torpor region .
If a combat finishes and the acting minion wishes to play Psyche
to restart but the blocker wants to play fast reaction to get another
vamp in combat with the acting minion - which takes precedence?
i hate these obscure questions

Messages.Author: Larry Harriman
Messages.Body:
Mr JA Chapman (jac...@aurora.cc.monash.edu.au) wrote:
: Two quesions . Can Graverobbing (superior) be used on ones own
: torporized vamps to give unblockable(except by Anneke or Eagles Sight)
: escape from torpor) . The card text does specify it can be used on vamps
: from 'Any' torpor region .

Directed actions can be directed at any _other_ metheseluh ( except
Rampage?!? ), so, no, you can't grace rob your own vampires.

: If a combat finishes and the acting minion wishes to play Psyche

: to restart but the blocker wants to play fast reaction to get another
: vamp in combat with the acting minion - which takes precedence?

The order is: acting minion, blocking minion, and then clockwise
around the table from the acting minion, so the Psyche combt would happpen
first.

: i hate these obscure questions
: JA Chapman

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
Mr JA Chapman <jac...@aurora.cc.monash.edu.au> wrote:
> Two quesions . Can Graverobbing (superior) be used on ones own
>torporized vamps to give unblockable(except by Anneke or Eagles Sight)
>escape from torpor) . The card text does specify it can be used on vamps
>from 'Any' torpor region .

I'm pretty sure the "to your own torpor" can only be successfully executed
if the vampire starts in someone else's torpor, but double check on that.
Having said that...

Grave Robbing is a directed action which can be blocked like any other
directed action. That action will involve taking moving the vampire in
torpor to your control, and possibly putting it into your ready region
as part of the action. No, the "move into ready region" may not be blocked
on its own, but you can still block the overall action.
